text:
Nina: FYI post-deploy wesaw an uptick in invoice-preview diffs. looks tied to DLQ replays from meter-ingest consumer. tagging @Elena (oncall) and @Marc
Jordan: what pattern in the DLQ? schema issues or upstream 5xxs?
Nina: sample DLQ item below, mostly fine schema. upstream returned 502 intermittently so we retried and preview consumer picked it up before ledger dedupe completed
Nina: ```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_9b7c",
  "tenant": "acct-234",
  "route": "embed-heavy",
  "tokens": 142,
  "error": "502 upstream timeout",
  "retry_count": 3
}
```
Priya: that ordering problem would cause inflated preview credits. ops needs visibility: expose dlq_retry_count and recent-replay QPS on the route detail page
Sam: also noticed we requeue DLQ items without a stable idempotency key at preview-ingest. adding request_fingerprint into DLQ payload before replay should be quick
Elena (oncall): can we disable DLQ replay for canary tenants until this is fixed? reduces false positives in invoices
Marc: short-term guard: if retry_count > 2, stop re-ingesting into preview stream and route to manual-review queue. prevents preview spikes
Jordan: plan: (1) add fingerprint + consumer dedupe (Sam) (2) telemetry: meter.dlq.replay.count & meter.dlq.retry_rate (Sam) (3) feature toggle on routing-service: preview-skip-dlq per-tenant (Marc)
Priya: UX: console badge on route preview: "DLQ replaying: N in last 10m" with link to runbook. need quick triage surface for billing ops
Sam: PR for (1) and (2) incoming in ~3h. (fingerprint is low-risk change)
Marc: for replay flow we'll add rate limiting per-tenant and a small circuit: if enrichment errors >10% over 5m, stop replay writes for preview and alert billing-bot. fallback: write to manual-review queue
Nina: that cascade you described earlier happened when one shard replayed too quickly and overloaded enrichment -> 429s -> more retries. rate limit + circuit makes sense
billing-bot: alert created: invoice-preview-dlq-replay-circuit tripped for acct-234 at 2026-03-22T02:10:11Z
Elena (oncall): I toggled preview-skip-dlq for the canary tenants as an immediate mitigation. monitoring diffs now
Jordan: owners & ETAs: Sam -> fingerprint + metrics PR (4h), Marc -> per-tenant replay limiter + circuit (EOD), Priya -> console badge mock + runbook link (EOD), Nina -> monitor and runbook (2h)
Priya: quick UX question: when previews are suppressed should we show the last cached preview or an explicit "suppressed due to DLQ replay" state? ops preference?
Elena (oncall): explicit suppressed state + runbook link avoids confusion and reduces 'is it broken' tickets
Marc: also please announce in #billing so CS knows previews may shift while flags flip
Jordan: pinged #support and #billing
Nina: logging action items, will follow up with a rollout checklist for canary -> global. thanks all :thumbsup:
